title: Emmitt Smith believes Derrick Henry can surpass him as NFL's all-time leading rusher

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Emmitt Smith believes Derrick Henry can surpass him as NFL's all-time leading rusher
sources.description: Henry's age-32 season started off with a boom, as the bowling ball of a running back piled up 144 yards and three touchdowns on the ground in a Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
